usedFor: CallRail holds tracked calls and text messages, and Anthropic Claude drafts a reply with “Generate Response” after “Text Message Received”.

bestTemplate.name: “Text Message Received” in CallRail, then “Generate Response” in Anthropic Claude
bestTemplate.why: The incoming text goes to the model along with past conversation, so the response can build on it.

watchOut: Anything that reaches a customer waits in Needs you for approval, so check the “Generate Response” output before it goes.
